## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: e⁻ n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, B 0 → 10 T) and h⁺ n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, B 10 → 0.3 T)

Raw |Rxx|(B) first, then the same trace vs 1/B, then the SdH FFT (B-space poly-5 background removed, FFT in 1/B) with `sdh_onset` tone tracking. Both at T ≈ 1.24 K, I = 9.9 nA, sr1 50 µV, no leakage (gate currents at their pA offsets throughout). **Run 6 (e⁻, F_L = 33.1 T from the run-5 n scale):** oscillations from ~1.7 T; the 3–10 T FFT is dominated by **F ≈ 30 T** (≈ F_L, i.e. the n scale is within ~10 % of the geometry prior) with a strong **7–8.6 T** tone and its multiples (15, 22 T). Minima at 5.9 / 7.2 / 8.5 / 9.75 T index to ν ≈ 20 / 16 / 14 / 12 for F = 29.4 T; a 500 Ω Rxx hump spans ν = 16 → 12. Two readings fit one trace equally: (a) a single 4-fold band whose dominant gaps are every Δν = 16 (F_L/4 harmonics — 16-fold zero-LL family), or (b) an ABAB light + heavy pair (7.3 + 30 T = F_L for n ≈ 3.6×10¹²). **Run 7 (h⁺, F_L = 12.4 T):** two strong tones, **7.1 and 12.6 T** (SNR 140 / 120), ΔF = 5.5 T — matches the series-mosaic region B (Δn = 0.43×10¹² → ΔF = 4.5 T) better than an 8-fold F_L/2 (6.3 T). **Take:** the device shows clean quantum oscillations to 10 T on both carrier signs — the fan is feasible. Every ambiguity above is a slope-in-n question (harmonics stay at fixed F/n; band pockets and mosaic regions do not) → Step 4, the D = 0 Landau fan.

# Runs 6-7 (sdh-spot-check): raw |Rxx|(B), vs 1/B, and the SdH FFT / tone tracking. R = (sr1_X/gain)/(sr0_X/gain_I) per point.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate(((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]; Rs = np.abs(R)
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T; R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm; I {I.mean()*1e9:.2f} nA; "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').mean():.3f} K; I_tg/I_bg max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f}/{np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA; interrupted={r.interrupted}")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, Rs, ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw")
    m = B > 1.5; sm = gaussian_filter1d(Rs[m], 1.5)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-sm, prominence=5); maxs, _ = find_peaks(sm, prominence=5)
    print("Rxx minima B =", np.round(B[m][mins], 2), "-> nu = 4 F_L/B =", np.round(4 * FL / B[m][mins], 1))
    ax[0, j].plot(B[m][mins], Rs[m][mins], "rv", ms=5); ax[0, j].plot(B[m][maxs], Rs[m][maxs], "g^", ms=5)
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], Rs[m], ".-", ms=2, lw=0.7); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    ax[1, j].set_title("vs 1/B (B > 1.5 T); grey = nu multiple of 4 for F_L")
    for k in range(1, 40):
        x = k / FL
        if 0.1 < x < 1 / 1.5: ax[1, j].axvline(x, color="gray", lw=0.4, alpha=0.5)
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(Rs, B, b_hi=10.0, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9); print(on.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("sdh_onset:", e)
    for lo, hi, col in ((1.5, 10.0, "k"), (1.5, 5.0, "C0"), (3.0, 10.0, "C1")):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(Rs[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = sp[0]; sel = (f > 2) & (f < 120)
        ax[2, j].plot(f[sel], sp[sel] / sp[sel].max(), col, lw=1, label=f"B {lo}-{hi} T")
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], prominence=0.1 * sp[sel].max())
        print(f"FFT {lo}-{hi} T peaks (T): {np.round(f[sel][pk], 1)} rel amp {np.round(sp[sel][pk]/sp[sel].max(), 2)}")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T (4-fold, all carriers)")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 2, color="r", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/2 (8-fold)"); ax[2, j].axvline(FL / 4, color="m", ls=":", lw=1, label="F_L/4 (16-fold)")
    ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); ax[2, j].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B (B-poly5 background removed)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² fast × B 0, 1.0 → 10 T slow

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 fast (151 pts, co-swept TG/BG along the run-5 D=0 line), B slow 0 then 1.0..10.0 T in 100 mT (92 rows), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1 s; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 V · **ETA ~12:06** (≈6h40m)

**Why (plan step 4; operator's request):** the spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show clean SdH on both carrier signs but every stacking-relevant read is degenerate on a single trace — the 7.3 / 15 / 22 / 30 T tones of run 6 are either F_L/4 harmonics (a 16-fold zero-LL family → ABCA-like) or an ABAB light + heavy pair; run 7's 7.1 + 12.6 T pair is either region B in series or an 8-fold F_L/2. A fan turns each into a slope in n: harmonics scale as fixed F/n, band pockets and mosaic regions do not, and the ν sequence with gaps at D = 0 (16 vs 8 vs 2/4 first) is read directly from the fan-line pattern. **Geometry:** fast axis = co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) along the calibrated D = 0 line (run-5 cal: c_bg/c_tg 0.773, n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm — the same CAL as runs 6–7), n −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 0.03 steps (151 pts; V_tg −0.291 → +0.998, V_bg −0.484 → +1.185 V, steps 8.6 / 11.1 mV), which is 8 points per Δν = 1 at 10 T and ≈ 9 per Δν = 4 at 3 T; slow axis = B, one B = 0 reference row (CNP position vs run 5) then 1.0 → 10.0 T in 100 mT (92 rows). Rows are sparse relative to the 1/B period at 1–2 T on the electron side (≈ 1 row per period) — the fan lines are resolved along n row by row, so that only limits 1D cuts, not the fan; the SdH spectra come from runs 6–7. **Coverage trade:** hole side stops at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) — only ν ≤ ~30 lines are visible there vs ≤ ~80 on the electron side; D = 0 only (a finite-D fan is the conditional step 6a, riding the magnet down). **Sensitivity:** sr1 100 µV = 10 kΩ full scale at 10 nA — sized to the ν = 0 ridge at 10 T (gatemap lesson: the extreme of the window, not the 1D peaks; runs 6–7 peaked at 590 Ω = 6 % of this range); the ν = 0 state at high B will likely rail over Δν ~ 1–2 (7–15 points) — accepted and flagged, the ν ≠ 0 lines are the measurement. **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.0 s (3.3 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, as in the run-5 gatemap — a ~1-point lag along n, common to all rows, correctable as a CNP shift); slow_delay 3 s after the flyback + the magnet's blocking ramp + 3 s settle. Leak guard trips at 1 nA (the TG flyback transient is ±110 pA). **Price:** per point 1.17–1.23 s (run 5: 4158 pts / 4873 s), 151 pts + ~7 s flyback/settle ≈ 193 s/row × 92 = 4.9 h, plus the 10 T ramp 73 min (bare 0.137 T/min) → ≈ 6 h 10 m; realistic **≈ 6 h 40 m**, ending at **10 T** with the gates parked at 0 V — subsequent steps ride the magnet down. **Checkpoints:** first row (B = 0: CNP at n ≈ 0 within ±0.1×10¹², R_CNP 200–350 Ω as run 5, no rail, gate currents at offsets, T 1.2–1.3 K); then at ≈ 3 T and ≈ 6 T a re-formed partial fan on the landed rows — abort if the channel rails away from ν = 0, a gate current climbs, T_sample drifts > 1.5 K, or the low-B rows show no fan structure at all.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow [0, 1.0 -> 10 T], n fast -1.25 -> +3.25e12 along the calibrated D = 0 line ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) — same CAL as runs 6–7 ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D_fan = 0.0                                                     # V/nm
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.25, 3.25 + 1e-9, 0.03), 4)        # 1e12 cm^-2, 151 pts
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, D_fan, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.asarray(Vtg_vec), np.asarray(Vbg_vec)
Vtg_s, Vbg_s = sanitize_tg_bg(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, tg_lims, bg_lims)
assert len(Vtg_s) == len(n_vec), f"D = 0 line leaves the operating box: {len(n_vec) - len(Vtg_s)} pts dropped"
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
n_chk, D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(n_chk, n_vec, atol=1e-6) and np.allclose(D_chk, D_fan, atol=1e-6)
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, {np.diff(n_vec).mean():.3f}e12/pt) at D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm; "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V ({np.diff(Vtg_vec).mean()*1e3:.1f} mV/pt), Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V ({np.diff(Vbg_vec).mean()*1e3:.1f} mV/pt)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency():.3f} Hz (1.0 V -> 10 nA)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3

# --- slow axis: B = 0 reference row, then 1.0 -> 10.0 T in 100 mT (blocking rate-limited magnet, ~44 s + 3 s settle per row)
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack(([0.0], np.arange(1.0, 10.0 + 1e-9, 0.1))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 100 uV = 10 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (sized to the nu = 0 ridge at 10 T).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} .. {B_vec[-1]} T (100 mT above 1 T); sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")
print(f"price: {len(B_vec)} rows x ({len(n_vec)} pts x 1.23 s + 7 s) + 73 min ramp ~ {(len(B_vec)*(len(n_vec)*1.23+7) + 73*60)/3600:.1f} h")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 fast ({len(n_vec)} pts, co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal), "
                  f"B slow 0 then 1.0..10.0 T 100 mT ({len(B_vec)} rows), Vsi = 0, sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm; fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 in {np.diff(n_vec).mean():.3f} steps ({len(n_vec)} pts) '
              f'co-swept (Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}->{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}->{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V); slow: B {B_vec[0]} then {B_vec[1]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T in 0.1 T ({len(B_vec)} rows); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2 (geometry prior), n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; Vsi = 0; T ~ 1.2 K')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates parked at 0 V; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T) — the next step rides it down, never re-traversing.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end state: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)

      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")

assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
